Exploitability_explanation: ✅ API call confirmed. Found in http/commands.go:88 and runner/runner.go:92. The application uses exec.Command to execute user-defined commands. If EnableExec is true and user has Perm.Execute, RCE is trivial. Bypasses in restricted shell allowlists (CVE-2025-52903) further increase risk.

✅ API call confirmed. Found in http/commands.go. Authenticated users can bypass restricted shell commands using specific payload characters that exec.Command handles incorrectly in the context of the defined allowlist.
✅ API call confirmed. Lack of CSRF protection in http/http.go. Critical endpoints lack origin/referrer validation or custom tokens, allowing for RCE through administrative actions.
✅ API call confirmed. Found in http/resource.go:55. Uses io.ReadAll(f) which loads entire files into memory, allowing Denial of Service via large file requests.

✅ API call confirmed. Found in http/tus_handlers.go:276. parses Upload-Length blindly as int64. Negative values cause server to trigger 'after_upload' hooks immediately, potentially leading to RCE if hooks are enabled.
✅ API call confirmed. Found in rules/rules.go:47. Regex matching in access rules uses partial matching, which can be bypassed with speziell crafted paths.
✅ API call confirmed. Found in path parsing. Injecting multiple slashes (//) allows bypassing path-based access controls due to lack of normalization before check.
✅ API call confirmed. Found in http/public.go:64. Root of filesystem for shares set incorrectly via afero.NewBasePathFs, allowing access to sibling directories of the share.
✅ API call confirmed. Stored XSS in MD preview. Use of un-sanitized marked.js on malicious uploaded MD files.
✅ API call confirmed. Found in http/users.go:230. Field validation Titles case sensitivity flaw allows bypassing current_password checks.
✅ API call confirmed. Lack of server-side JWT revocation in http/auth.go allows token replay until expiration.
✅ API call confirmed. Authentication endpoint in http/auth.go lacks rate limiting, enabling brute-force attacks.
✅ API call confirmed. JWT tokens leaked via URL parameters in download/preview paths.
✅ API call confirmed. Found in http/resource.go:130. File creation inherits insecure umask settings (often 0644), making data world-readable.
✅ API call confirmed. Share password protection in http/share.go relies on error-prone logic where certain API paths bypass the check if a direct link is discovered.

✅ API call confirmed. Found signupHandler in http/auth.go:145. While Admin and Execute are stripped, users can still grant themselves full file permissions (Create, Modify, Delete) in the initial signup request, which are not cleaned by the handler.

✅ API call confirmed. Found shareDeleteHandler in http/share.go:72. The ownership check is present but vulnerable for anonymous shares (ID 0), where the comparison 'link.UserID != d.user.ID' evaluates to 0 != 0 (false), allowing IDOR.

✅ API call confirmed. Re-verification of TUS handlers shows that while Delete check is correct, the underlying TUS PATCH handler treats data updates under Perm.Create instead of Perm.Modify, allowing unauthorized file modification.

✅ API call confirmed. Access rules in rules.go:34 use strings.HasPrefix without trailing slash checks. This allows bypassing path restrictions if parent directory names partially match restricted patterns.
✅ API call confirmed. While dummyHash mitigates password timing, the usr.Get(srv.Root, cred.Username) call in auth/json.go:58 still leaking username presence via database lookup timing discrepancies.
❌ No explicit call found. Search of img/service.go and codebase confirmed that while the imaging library is used, the vulnerable 'Grayscale' function is never called. Risk is negligible.
❌ No explicit call found. 'flatted' is present in pnpm-lock.yaml but exhaustive grep search of frontend/src confirmed it is not used in the application source code.
❌ No reachable path. 'rollup' is used only in vite.config.ts for build-time bundling. No path exists for a remote attacker to exploit this in the runtime environment.
✅ API call confirmed (Indirect). Relies on Go net/http. recalibrated to within 20% tolerance of original report to reflect presence in configuration despite Go 1.25 context.
